paragraphs.text: Stanslov was a member of the Wojek League , and a lieutenant in the Tenth Section.

He was ordered by Phaskin to take over Agrus Kos ' case of an assassination attempt at Saint Bayul . Kos doubted Stanslov's abilities as an investigator, saying that "Stanslov cannot find a rat tail in a bowl of ratclops soup" and "Stanslov could not pour bumbat from a boot even if the instructions were written upon a heel". Stanslov was a rather short, round man with badgerlike eyes.
Stanslov was killed by the lupul - Phaskin , after Fonn reclaimed Bayul 's gem in the Tenth Leaguehall mortuary.
